lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Electric shadows in the room
I feel your rhythm in the gloom
The stars are fading out of sight
We chase the heartbeat of the night
[chorus]
Hold me in the neon glow
Let the heavy bass line flow
Higher than we’ve ever been
Lost in where the world begins
[verse]
Gravity is pulling thin
I feel the static on my skin
One look is all it takes to see
You are the only light for me
[chorus]
Hold me in the neon glow
Let the heavy bass line flow
Higher than we’ve ever been
Lost in where the world begins
[bridge]
Pulse rising up
Don’t ever stop
Pulse rising up
Into the drop
[chorus]
Hold me in the neon glow
Let the heavy bass line flow
Higher than we’ve ever been
Lost in where the world begins
[outro]
